Name: Em's Seasonal Fishpond
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
A seasonal retexture of the fish pond to hide between grass and natural paths
Each season, the pond changes its grass, but the little frog stays, looking after your fish
Available for Content Patcher

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55894/55894-1795363854-327832356.png[/img]

Like the original fish pond, there are four decoration options: [color=#e69138]plain[/color], two [color=#e69138]fishrods[/color] and a [color=#e69138]seasonal[/color] option
To change the decoration, the pond needs to have at least one fish
Right-click on the pond to open the menu and click on the raster with a red square
The initial decoration is chosen randomly when you build the pond and can be changed any time

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55894/55894-1795364227-1196212831.png[/img]

The fish pond has set limitations in size due to its animations, meaning I can only do so much to change its layout
The left/bottom blends in perfectly with the grass. The right side of the pond has a small gap between the grass you place and the grass from the pond. This is best worked around by placing a path or leaving an open area on that side

Ponds can be placed together, just like the vanilla ponds, but aren't able to connect. There will always be a small gap between them. By adding patches of grass and paths, you can still make it look like they belong together!

[i]There are currently no map recolour compatibilities or AT files. I am wokring on those for the next update! Including an option to unfreeze the pond in winter for those who have Visable Fish installed[/i]
